defect.cause: resetAfterLoss initializes both waveBreak and enemyTimer to 4 seconds; because enemyTimer only counts down after waveBreak ends, first restarted JUNK is delayed about eight seconds rather than the initial approximately four-second grace.
defect.reproduction: The accepted whole-server base-loss regression establishes a reset and a 3.9-second grace. New canonical whole-server regression checks 14 x 0.3-second beats with no JUNK followed by one JUNK at 15 beats (4.5 seconds); pinned old source must still have zero at 4.5 seconds.
defect.evidence_scope: Native deterministic Lua mock; no Roblox engine or player observation.

fix: Set only resetAfterLoss enemyTimer from 4 to 0.1, matching the initial wave timer after its 4-second grace. Keep waveBreak=4, spawn interval=2.3, unit stats and all other logic unchanged.
character_impact: JUNK first spawn after a defeated-base restart becomes earlier; no PON/GUARDON/TANKURU/JUNK stats, prices, damage or visual assets change.
